sources.title: Bucs list QB Baker Mayfield as full participant, WR Emeka Egbuka with concussion after first practice of Week 7
sources.description: Mayfield returned to practice for the first time since dislocating the thumb on his throwing hand in a Week 3 loss to the Vikings.
